description: Astronomers have identified CDG-2, a faint galaxy in the Perseus cluster that appears to be composed almost entirely of dark matter. Located 300 million light-years from Earth, it was discovered by tracking globular star clusters using data from Hubble, Euclid, and Subaru telescopes. Scientists estimate that about 99% of its total mass is dark matter.
title: Astronomers Find ‘Impossible’ Galaxy ACDG-2 With Virtually No Stars and a Massive Dark Matter Core

description: Cairn, released on PC and PS5 on January 29, is a game about climbing a mountain. It is a game about grit, patience, and humility. It is also a game about what it means to be a part of that small minority of people who go do things unfathomable to normal people. And Cairn balances all its ideas with the grace of a seasoned climber on a familiar rock face.
title: Cairn Review: Moving a Mountain

description: Google is reportedly rolling out Call Recording in the Pixel Phone app to more countries beyond the United States. According to a new report, users in several European markets have started receiving the feature, with Google confirming availability in supported regions by the end of February, subject to local laws. The feature works on Pixel 6 and newer devices running Android 14 or later. It allows manual or automatic recording with mandatory audio notifications and flexible storage options.
title: Google Pixel Call Recording Reportedly Available in Additional Regions Ahead of Global Expansion

description: Oppo Find X9 Ultra will be equipped with a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto camera with a 1/1.28-inch sensor on the back, according to a tipster. Moreover, the upcoming handset is tipped to also feature a secondary 50-megapixel telephoto camera on the back with up to 10x optical zoom capabilities. On the other hand, the Vivo X300 Ultra could be launched with a triple rear camera setup, headlined by a 200-megapixel primary shooter with a 1/12-inch sensor and 35mm focal length. This comes shortly after Oppo’s executive confirmed that the Find X9 Ultra will pack a battery exceeding 7,000mAh capacity.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra, Vivo X300 Ultra Leak: Tipster Shares Details of Anticipated 200-Megapixel Cameras

description: Hello Bachhon is an upcoming inspirational drama series streaming on Netflix from March 6, 2026. Inspired by real-life educator Alakh Pandey, the show follows a passionate physics teacher who fights the rigid education system to empower students. With emotional storytelling and a motivational theme, the series aims to connect deeply with students and young audiences, though its IMDb rating is yet to be established.
title: Hello Bachhon OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Vineet Kumar Singh Starrer Online?

description: The Poco X8 Pro series is expected to launch globally soon, with multiple models tipped to debut under the lineup. Recent reports suggest that at least two variants — the Poco X8 Pro and Poco X8 Pro Max — could be unveiled as the successor to 2025’s X7 lineup. While the Xiaomi sub-brand has yet to confirm the handsets, new renders of the Poco X8 Pro and Poco X8 Pro Max have been leaked online by a tipster, offering a detailed look at their design and colour options.
title: Poco X8 Pro, Poco X8 Pro Max Design and Colour Options Seen in Leaked Renders

description: Redmi A7 could launch soon, as it has surfaced on Thailand's National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) certification website. The listing revealed its model number and connectivity options. It could be launched alongside the Redmi A7 Pro. The Redmi A7 is rumoured to feature a 6.9-inch display and could run on the Unisoc T7250 chipset.
title: Redmi A7 Could Launch Soon as Handset Bags Thailand’s NBTC Certification

description: This list highlights top colour LaserJet printers in India for students and professionals. Options range from compact print only models like the HP Colour Laser 150nw to feature rich multifunction devices such as the HP 3303sdw, Brother DCP L3560CDW, and Canon imageCLASS MF645Cx. Key features include automatic duplex printing, wireless connectivity, mobile printing support, high duty cycles, and touchscreen controls. Prices start at Rs. 33,990 and go up to Rs. 69,850 depending on features.
title: Top Colour Laserjet Printers for Students and Professionals in India

description: Theatre – The Myth of Reality is an artistic Malayalam mystery film starring Rima Kallingal and directed by Sajin Baabu. Now streaming on Manorama Max, the film explores myths, superstitions, and reality through a slow and atmospheric narrative, earning strong critical praise and an IMDb rating of 8.5/10.
title: Theatre: The Myth of Reality OTT Release: Where to Watch Kerala Film Critics Award-Winning Movie Online?

description: Google on Thursday detailed its new enforcement measures to keep the Android ecosystem secure in 2025. In its annual security update, the Mountain View-based tech giant highlighted how it strengthened protections across Google Play, while blocking millions of harmful apps that could’ve spread malware, financial fraud, hidden subscriptions, and privacy invasions, before they could reach users.
title: Google Blocked 266 Million Risky App Installs, Prevented 1.75 Million Policy-Violating Apps in 2025

description: Google, on Thursday, released the Gemini 3.1 Pro AI model, the latest addition to the Gemini 3 series, which was launched in November last year. The new model is claimed to have been designed to perform more complex tasks than the Gemini 3 Pro. It is now available to all users in the Gemini app. However, Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers get higher rate limits for the same. The paid users can also access the Gemini 3.1 Pro AI model in NotebookLM. Separately, Google Labs has introduced the Photoshoot feature for its marketing AI platform Pomelli.
title: Google Releases Gemini 3.1 Pro With Ability to Execute Complex Tasks; Pomelli Gets New Photoshoot Feature

description: Motorola has teased the Edge 70 Fusion on Flipkart ahead of its India launch, with more details set for February 23. Leaked marketing images confirm the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset and up to 12GB RAM. The phone may feature a 6.78-inch 144Hz quad curved OLED display, IP68 and IP69 ratings, and a 7,000mAh battery with 68W fast charging. It is also expected to offer leather-inspired finishes in multiple Pantone-curated colours.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Fusion India Launch Teased on Flipkart; Leaked Marketing Image Hints at Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 SoC

description: The OTT platforms are set to buzz your screens with top movies and series that include Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri, Kennedy, The Night Agent S3, and more.
title: OTT Releases of the Week (Feb 16 - Feb 22): Kennedy, Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri, Paathirathri, and More

description: Realme C83 5G price in India, along with RAM and storage configurations have been leaked online ahead of its official launch in the country. The C-series smartphone is tipped to come in three RAM and storage options with up to 6GB of onboard memory and a maximum of 128GB of storage. It could be offered in two colour options. It could come with a starting price tag of Rs. 13,499 and is likely to sit below the Realme C85 5G in the market.
title: Realme C83 5G India Price, RAM and Storage Configurations Leaked Online

description: Xiaomi will launch the Xiaomi 17 series globally in Barcelona on February 28, with the Xiaomi 17 and Xiaomi 17 Ultra expected. The Ultra has appeared on Geekbench, and pricing details have surfaced. The Xiaomi 17 may start at EUR 999 (roughly Rs. 1,07,000), while the Ultra could begin at EUR 1,499 (roughly Rs. 1,61,000). Buyers will receive a 24-month quality assurance plan and one free screen replacement. The India pricing is expected to be higher than their predecessors.
title: Xiaomi 17 Series Global Launch Date Announced; Xiaomi 17, Xiaomi 17 Ultra Expected to Debut

description: Xiaomi introduced the Xiaomi 15T and Xiaomi 14T in September in previous years. However, a new leak suggests that the Chinese tech brand will change this launch pattern this year. The Xiaomi 17T series is tipped to launch in May. The standard Xiaomi 17T is said to run on a MediaTek Dimensity 8500 chipset, while the Xiaomi 17T Pro variant could run on the Dimensity 9500 SoC.
title: Xiaomi 17T Pro, Xiaomi 17T Tipped to Launch Earlier Than Previously Expected, Chipset Details Leaked

description: Xiaomi Pad 8 Pro was launched in China in September 2025, along with the Xiaomi 17 Pro Max, Xiaomi 17 Pro, and Xiaomi 17. The company recently announced that the Xiaomi 17 Ultra and Xiaomi 17 will be unveiled in select global markets on February 28. Now, Xiaomi has also teased that it will soon launch a new "computing" device in India, which could be a laptop or a tablet with a backlit keyboard. However, Sandeep Sarma of Xiaomi India has also hinted that the upcoming device could be a tablet.
title: Xiaomi Teases India Launch of New Computing Device; New Tablet With Keyboard or Laptop Expected

description: Google announced a new set of productivity-focused improvements for the Google Chrome browser on Thursday. The Mountain View-based tech giant says the new additions are aimed at helping everyday and enterprise users manage tabs more efficiently and complete tasks faster. Among the updates is a new tab organisation tool called Split View, which displays two tabs at the same time.
title: Google Chrome Updated With Split View, Built-In PDF Markup Tools, and More Features

description: Realme P4 Lite has been launched in India by the Chinese smartphone maker as the latest addition to its smartphone lineup. The handset will go on sale in the country on February 24 via Flipkart and the Realme India online store. It is currently available for pre-ordering in Beach Gold, Obsidian Black, and Sea Blue colour options. The phone is backed by a 6,300mAh battery. It features 15W wired charging support. The new Realme P4 Lite is powered by a Unisoc T7250 chipset, along with 4GB of RAM and up to 128GB of internal storage.
title: Realme P4 Lite Launched in India With 6,300mAh Battery, 13-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung is expected to unveil the Galaxy Buds 4 and Galaxy Buds 4 Pro at its February 25 Unpacked event. An accidental Amazon India listing and leaked dummy units suggest a flatter stem design and refreshed look. The Buds 4 may feature an open fit style, while the Pro model retains ear tips. Both are tipped to support ANC. The Pro could offer an IP57 rating and 26 hours of battery life. Pricing may start at EUR 179 (roughly Rs. 19,200).
title: Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Leak Again as Dummy Units Surface Online: Expected Price, Features

description: Amazfit T-Rex Ultra 2 has been launched in global markets with Bluetooth calling support and a 1.5-inch AMOLED display. The rugged smartwatch has a 10 ATM water resistance rating and is said to deliver up to 50 hours of battery life with GPS tracking. It supports 187 sports modes and features 64GB of onboard storage. It monitors heart rate, blood-oxygen saturation (SpO2), stress and skin temperature.
title: Amazfit T-Rex Ultra 2 Launched With BioTracker 6.0 Sensor, 1.5-Inch AMOLED Display

description: Sony is shutting down Bluepoint Games, the developer behind acclaimed remakes and remasters like Demon's Souls, Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection, and Shadow of the Colossus. Sony said roughly 70 employees would be laid off as a result of the studio's closure. Bluepoint will shut operations in March.
title: Sony to Shut Down Demon's Souls Remake Developer Bluepoint Games in March

description: Isha is a Telugu psychological horror-thriller film that has been written and directed by Manne Srinivas. The film is now streaming on Amazon Prime Video in the Telugu language with English subtitles. The film features an ensemble cast led by Thrigun, Hebah Patel, Siri Hanmanth, and Akhil Raj Uddemari.
title: Isha Streaming on Prime Video: What You Need to Know About Hebah Patel and Thrigun Starrer

description: Apple’s C1X model, which is found on the iPhone Air, “suddenly” malfunctioned, a Reddit user complains. The user said that, on Thursday, he woke up to find his iPhone Air not receiving cellular reception. Upon running mobile diagnostics, the user found that a hardware issue had been detected. They claimed that the phone had no physical damage. Apple launched the iPhone Air in September 2025, claiming the phone to be the thinnest iPhone model ever. The handset features Apple’s C1X modem, which is claimed to be faster and more efficient than the C1 modem found on the iPhone 16e.
title: iPhone Air User Complains of C1X Modem Failure, Claims Mobile Diagnostics Suggests Hardware Issue

description: Xiaomi is reportedly preparing to launch the Redmi Buds 8 Active as a more affordable option below the Redmi Buds 8 Lite. Leaked renders suggest a semi-in-ear design with a similar stem and case design, offered in Blue, Black, and White. The earbuds are expected to feature a 14.2mm driver, AAC support, AI call noise reduction, Bluetooth 5.4, and multipoint connectivity. They may offer up to 37 hours of total battery life and launch at EUR 19.99 (roughly Rs. 2,100).
title: Redmi Buds 8 Active Price, Design, Key Features Leaked Ahead of Anticipated Launch

description: Samsung Electronics today announced the beta program for its latest version of Bixby. With the latest update, users can ask the on-device assistant for what they need through natural language. Additionally, it expands access to up-to-date answers from the open web. Samsung's updated Bixby experience in One UI 8.5 is currently available in select markets like Germany, India, Korea, Poland, the UK, and the US. Samsung has planned a wider rollout in the coming months.
title: Samsung's One UI 8.5 Update Will Introduce Upgraded Bixby With Natural Voice Commands, Real-Time Web Access

description: Boeing’s Starliner test flight has been reclassified by NASA as a Type A mishap after propulsion anomalies extended the mission from days to 93 days. Helium leaks and thruster failures during docking raised safety concerns and exposed technical and leadership shortcomings. An investigation issued 61 recommendations, and NASA says no additional crews will fly aboard Starliner until all issues are fully resolved and corrective measures are implemented before certification.
title: Boeing Starliner Test Flight Stretches to 93 Days as Engineers Struggle With Propulsion Thruster Issues

description: The Poco X8 series is rumoured to launch soon in global markets as the successor to the 2025 Poco X7 lineup. Ahead of its anticipated debut, specifications of the Poco X8 Pro and X8 Pro Max models have surfaced in a fresh leak. According to a tipster, the purported handsets from the Xiaomi sub-brand will feature 1.5K 120Hz OLED screens, up to IP69K ingress protection ratings, and up to 100W fast charging support.
title: Poco X8 Pro and Poco X8 Pro Max to Feature 1.5K OLED Screens, 100W Charging Support, Tipster Claims

description: WhatsApp on Friday announced a new feature for its app, which is aimed at reducing interruptions in group conversations. Dubbed Group Message History, it simplifies group onboarding without compromising user privacy by eliminating the need for manually forwarding older messages, while adhering to end-to-end encryption policies. The instant messaging platform says group administrators have a choice of whether to share the previous message history with new members.
title: WhatsApp Rolls Out Group Message History Feature for Easy Onboarding of New Members
